newsitem.title: USA: US stocks rise at opening, Dow led up by DuPont.
newsitem.headline: US stocks rise at opening, Dow led up by DuPont.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened higher on Thursday after August durable goods data eased the fear of inflation.
DuPont led the Dow higher after forecasting strong third quarter earnings.
Dow industrials rose 11 points to 5888. The NASDAQ Index added four to 1229.
Orders for costly manufactured goods tumbled at the sharpest rate in 16 months during August, the Commerce Department said, as demand weakened for nearly every category of product.

New orders for durable goods dropped 3.1 percent to a seasonally adjusted $167 billion -- the biggest monthly decline since a 3.4 percent plunge in April l995 -- after a revised 1.4 percent rise in July.
